description: One attachment from a message in YOUR Outlook mailbox (message_id + attachment_id from get_outlook_thread), as base64, 5 MB max. PDF and images unless allow_any_type. Read-only. Sign-in required.

allow_any_type.description: Also return non-PDF, non-image files. Defaults to false.

name: get_outlook_attachment
title: Get an Outlook attachment
